narration: Welcome to the Jewellery Gallery, where this exquisite Emerald and Gold Necklace—catalogued as NM 91.2/8—awaits your admiration. Crafted in the early 20th century in Hyderabad, this layered gold chain is set with cabochon-cut emeralds and delicate seed pearls, a style that was highly prized by the princely court of the Deccan. Measuring 32 centimetres in length, the necklace showcases the intricate metalwork and gemstone setting that reflect the opulent aesthetic of the era. Though the museum’s curatorial notes are still being expanded, this piece offers a glimpse into the luxurious jewelry traditions that once adorned the Hyderabad royalty.
